Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor intake - Parallax Systems (legal name + remit)

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the quick intro — I'm Daniel, head of finance ops at Parallax Systems. We're ready to get into Redwood's vendor system so your procurement team can send POs. Per your intake form, I'm attaching our tax proof and remit sheet. A couple of clarifications below so we don't block POs: 

- Legal entity: "Parallax Systems, Inc." (registered in DE)
- DBA: Parallax (marketing name) — we invoice as Parallax Systems, Inc.
- Tax ID: 12-3456789 (EIN) — W-8/W-9 position will depend on entity tax status; sending W-8BEN-E since Parallax is a Cayman parent and US subsidiary invoices will be by the US entity.
- Default remit email: accounts@parallax.io
- Preferred PO channel: email is fine for now; we can also accept Ariba later.

I've attached Parallax_W-8BEN.pdf and a small remit workbook (parallax_remit_sheet.xlsx) that contains AP contact, invoice examples, and the remit address for ACH. Please confirm which legal name you will register under, and whether we should expect any extra forms for tax/accounting.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Norwood
Head of Finance Ops
Parallax Systems

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor intake - Parallax Systems (legal name + remit)

Hi Daniel — great, thanks for sending these over and for the clear remit sheet. Quick follow-ups so procurement can create the vendor record without back-and-forth: 

1) Confirm legal-paying entity: you mentioned a Cayman parent and US subsidiary. Which entity will be listed on Redwood invoices and receive PO funds? We need the exact legal name that matches the EIN you provided.
2) Tax form: you attached a W-8BEN (individual). Our tax team usually needs W-8BEN-E (entity) for non-US entities, or W-9 for US entities. Can you confirm the appropriate entity-level form for the vendor that will invoice Redwood?
3) Remit address vs. ACH: the remit workbook lists both — please confirm the ACH receiving bank name and whether the account is under the legal entity name you will provide. For security, we don't need bank details in email, but AP portal will request them via encrypted upload.

If it's easier, Kar thik (cc'd) handles vendor creation and PO routing mapping — Kar thik, once Daniel confirms the legal invoicing entity and tax form, can you confirm whether Redwood will:
- register Parallax under a US vendor record (W-9) or an international vendor record (W-8 series), and
- how POs will be routed (email to accounts@parallax.io vs. Ariba supplier ID)

I'll hold on creating the vendor until we have the entity name that matches the tax doc.

Best,
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference
